newsitem.title: THAILAND: 17 die in Burmese clash with rebels - Thai army.
newsitem.headline: 17 die in Burmese clash with rebels - Thai army.

text.p: At least 17 people, including 12 Burmese soldiers and five Karenni rebels, were killed in heavy clashes in Burma's northwestern Kayah state over the weekend, Thai army sources said on Tuesday.

Rebels of the Karenni National Progress Party (KNPP), which wants autonomy from Rangoon for small pockets of area under its control, clashed with the Burmese troops while escorting Karenni refugees to a camp on the Thai border, the sources told Reuters.
News of the attack, about 10 kms (six miles) inside Burmese territory, was given by Karenni refugee survivors from the clashes, the army added.

The KNPP early last year agreed a ceasefire with the ruling Burmese State Law and Order Restoration Council, but broke it after accusing the military junta of violating the truce by sending thousands of troops to areas under rebel control.
Continuing clashes have seen an influx of Karenni refugees into Thailand with about 10,000 of them living in jungles camps on the border with Burma.
